# Verify Operations Handbook

## 1. Scope

This handbook exists only for the HoloDeck live verify suite.

## 2. Equipment

### 2.1 Calibration

The calibration constant for the verify rig is ORBIT-9182.
Recalibrate the rig every 30 days.

### 2.2 Storage

Store the rig in Bay V when it is not in use.
